components.name: Diagram/Connector
components.description: Arrow between Diagram nodes. Straight = main flow, Dashed = optional / async, Elbow = orthogonal turn (prefer over diagonals), Labeled = decision branch (Yes / No). Stroke chart/line/stroke in dataviz/label; arrow head 8×10. Resize along the flow axis; the head stays pinned to the end. React: <DiagramEdge variant label? />
